name: Grand Hotel Savoia
positioning: Five-star hotel dating back to the early 20th century in the heart of Cortina d'Ampezzo in the Dolomites, part of Radisson Collection, with chalet-inspired rooms and the Savoia SPA
best_for: Skiers and summer hikers who want a base in the heart of Cortina
Families, couples on a romantic getaway and outdoor adventurers

facts.text: For over a century the hotel has had a ringside seat in Cortina d'Ampezzo, gateway to the Dolomites.
The hotel is in the heart of Cortina.
The hotel is part of Radisson Collection.
The refurbished rooms and suites are designed with a sense of contemporary luxury.
Guests can enjoy views from every room and from the terraces.
The rooms have hi-tech facilities to keep guests connected.
The hotel has rooms for family breaks, romantic getaways and outdoor adventures.
Savoia SPA uses Comfort Zone products.
The hotel's restaurant is the Savoy restaurant.

highlights.text: Rooms are inspired by the traditional mountain chalet, snug and wood-lined.
The Grand Hotel Savoia dates back to the early 20th century.
The Savoia SPA offers treatments based on the use of water, steam and heat.
The 1224 Terrazza is an open-air lounge with views of Cortina and the Ampezzo Valley.
Rooms combine parquet flooring with luxurious fabrics and fittings, with views over the town and mountainscape.

considerations.text: What there is to do outdoors depends on the season: skiing and winter sports in the cold season, and long walks, trekking and mountain biking in summer.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the exclusive Cortina location.
WhataHotel notes the traditional decor may feel formal for some guests.
